query: Add a chat panel that streams tokens from our own Python service over SSE into a client component. Show the chat capability's public stream surface, the Route Handler, the transport call, and how failures and cancellation are handled.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent reaches for a Server Action, or makes the Route Handler reuse ordinary request/response semantics: a whole-request timeout, blind full-stream retries, no abort propagation, and an HTTP error after the first byte.
expected_behavior: Uses a Route Handler plus modules/chat/stream.ts because this channel owns headers, status, cancellation, and a streaming body
Keeps Route Handler auth and decoding local or shared and imports only the chat root stream surface, never modules/chat/server/**
Acquires the upstream stream before returning Response when startup failures need an HTTP status
Resumes from the last delivered event id instead of retrying the whole stream
Bounds the idle gap between events rather than the total duration
Uses one channel-owned AbortController so both the incoming request signal and downstream ReadableStream cancel abort the outgoing producer
Delivers post-headers failures as a terminal in-stream event, not a status code
Keeps stream idle timeout distinct from any background job deadline
anti_expectation: Does NOT apply stream handling to ordinary request/response calls to the same service
Does NOT import private chat auth, validation, provider, or composition files from app/**
Does NOT mark the response committed immediately after constructing a ReadableStream while upstream acquisition is still pending
Does NOT claim cancellation after only setting a local boolean or stopping local iteration
Does NOT treat a silent disconnect and a terminal error event as the same condition
Does NOT accumulate stream state inside the presentational component
